requirements.quote: (vii) use proposal information obtained through site visits, management interviews and the Authority’s investigation of a proposer’s qualifications, experience, ability or financial standing, and any material or information submitted by the proposer in response to the agency’s request for clarifying information in the course of evaluation and/or selection under the RFP;
requirements.text: Use proposal information from site visits, interviews, and investigations.

requirements.quote: (viii) prior to the bid opening, amend the RFP specifications to correct errors or oversights, or to supply additional information, as it becomes available;
requirements.text: Amend RFP specifications before bid opening to correct errors or add information.

requirements.quote: (ix) prior to the bid opening, direct proposers to submit proposal modifications addressing subsequent RFP amendments;
requirements.text: Direct proposers to submit modifications addressing RFP amendments before bid opening.

requirements.quote: (x) change any of the scheduled dates;
(xi) eliminate any mandatory, non-material specifications that cannot be complied with by all of the prospective proposers;
requirements.text: Eliminate non-material specifications that cannot be met by all proposers.

requirements.quote: (xii) waive any requirements that are not material;
(xiii) negotiate with the successful proposer within the scope of the RFP in the best interests of the Authority;
requirements.text: Negotiate with the successful proposer within RFP scope.

requirements.quote: (xiv) conduct contract negotiations with the next responsible proposer, should the Authority be unsuccessful in negotiating with the selected proposer;
requirements.text: Negotiate with the next proposer if negotiations fail with the selected one.

requirements.quote: (xv) utilize any and all ideas submitted in the proposals received;
(xvi) unless otherwise specified in the solicitation, every submission is a firm offer and not revocable for a period of 60 days from the bid opening;
requirements.text: Submissions are firm offers not revocable for 60 days post bid opening.

requirements.quote: (xvii) require clarification at any time during the procurement process and/or require correction of arithmetic or other apparent errors for the purpose of assuring a full and complete understanding of an offerer’s proposal and/or to determine an offerer’s compliance with the requirements of the solicitation.
requirements.text: Require clarification or correction of errors during procurement.

requirements.quote: (xviii) waive or modify minor deviations in the proposals received after prior notification to the Proposers;
requirements.text: Waive or modify minor deviations in proposals after notifying proposers.

requirements.quote: (xx) Should the Authority be unsuccessful in negotiating a contract with a selected Proposer, the Authority may begin contract negotiations with the next highest-rated qualified Proposer.
requirements.text: Begin negotiations with the next highest-rated proposer if negotiations fail.
